moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games Underway
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games are currently in full swing in Glasgow, Scotland, running from July 23rd to August 2nd, featuring over 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across 10 sports.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are delivering incredible sporting moments this week, with athletes from across the Commonwealth battling for gold. Who are you cheering for?

angles.name: Scottish Focus
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games have transformed Glasgow into a hub of sporting excellence! So many incredible performances happening right here in Scotland.

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Tee-Off
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open, one of golf's five majors, begins on Wednesday, July 29th, at Royal Lytham & St Annes in Lancashire, running until August 2nd.

angles.name: Golf Excitement
angles.copy: Major golf alert! The AIG Women's Open starts Wednesday at Royal Lytham & St Annes. Get ready for some world-class action on the links.

angles.name: Lancashire Local
angles.copy: The world's best women golfers descend on Lancashire this week for the AIG Women's Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Countdown

moments.title: Love Island UK Grand Finale
moments.blurb: The 13th series of Love Island UK concludes tomorrow, Monday July 27th, with the grand finale airing on ITV2 and ITVX.

angles.name: Finale Buzz

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the UK Singles Chart as of July 23rd, 2026, marking its 18th non-consecutive week at the top, matching the longest-running UK No.1 single ever.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at No.1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is dominating the UK Singles Chart, making history with its incredible run. What a track!

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: Eighteen weeks and counting! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean has officially matched the record for longest-running UK No.1. An iconic chart moment!

angles.name: Glasgow Gigs

moments.title: Mixed Summer Weather & August Heatwave Potential
moments.blurb: After recent heatwaves, the UK is currently experiencing more typical mixed summer weather (18-24°C), though some long-range forecasts hint at another spell of 30°C+ temperatures returning, particularly for southern and central England, after the second week of August.

angles.name: Current Weather
angles.copy: Mixed bag of summer weather this week! Remember to make the most of those sunny spells, and keep an eye out for those classic British showers. 🌦️

angles.name: August Outlook
angles.copy: Could another heatwave be on the cards for August? While it's a bit cooler now, some forecasts suggest 30°C+ temperatures might return later next month. Stay tuned!
